notes_for_editor: The register page lists no coordinates, so the record's point 41.80666, -77.35464 has no register source; MyHikes lists the Oak Ridge Trail at 41.808342, -77.355826, which is close to the record but does not show a tower. Neither page read says who built the tower, its height, when it came down, or what remains. Searches found no Tioga County Oak Ridge lookout; the Oak Ridge observation tower in Gettysburg is a different structure and was not used. Trail access note is dated (September 2021) and comes from a trail guide, not an agency.
